_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Companion phrase pack: phrases/pop/. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Pop
blurb: Chart pop: a straight-8 piano pulse with add9 sheen, offbeat synth stabs, and an octave-pumping bass under four-on-the-floor claps.

flavors.label: Axis Anthem
flavors.blurb: The big four-chord chorus: I-V-vi-IV on a straight-eight piano pulse with add9 sheen.

flavors.label: Sad Banger
flavors.blurb: Minor-key dance pop: i-bVII-bVI stabbed short and hard over four-on-the-floor.

flavors.label: Piano Ballad
flavors.blurb: Half the changes, twice the sustain: held doo-wop harmony with 7ths and a little rubato.

flavors.label: Motown Lift
flavors.blurb: I-iii-IV-Vsus4 rising under handclaps -- the gospel lift into the last chorus.

flavors.label: One Chord Hook
flavors.blurb: The whole loop parked on one sus2 chord, stabbed short on the offbeats while the beat and the topline do the work.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Chart pop lives on four-bar diatonic loops -- Axis rotations of I-V-vi-IV, doo-wop I-vi-IV-V, and the minor i-bVII-bVI. Triads with add9 sheen, sus2 and sus4 instead of dominant 7ths. One chord per bar, no modulation, no secondary dominants. The loop should feel inevitable on the first pass and survive fifty repeats.
